text:
GENERATE BURST K5-plate-K1 — in-scene register probe (Q74), scene plate in register K1: Hollow-Knight-side (flat ink-and-wash). task_id "K5-plate-K1".

Deliver EXACTLY ONE image, one image_gen call, LANDSCAPE, from the description below. Name: out/k5_plate_K1.png. NO retries: one call; calls_used must equal 1. NO reference images.

DESCRIPTION (use it verbatim as the content of the call):
Keeper of Hours — SCENE PLATE for an in-scene register test. An interior: the Keepers' archive hall — a worn grey flagstone floor filling most of the frame, a low stone plinth with stacked ledgers and a brass hour-glass at the upper-left, a dark wooden shelf of scroll-tubes along the far wall at the top edge, a few fallen pages and a coil of rope on the floor, deep shadowed alcoves. Elevated three-quarter camera (projection C, the ARPG camera): the floor is the play surface and occupies the lower two-thirds of the frame, the far wall the upper third; NO characters, NO creatures, NO text, NO UI. LANDSCAPE 1536×1024. Register: FLAT INK-AND-WASH 2D — clean uniform ink outline, flat colour fills with at most one wash of shadow, no painted texture, no gradients, muted palette, graphic and minimal; a frame of hand-drawn cel animation. Light: single key from SCREEN UPPER-LEFT, deep cool low-value ambient, readable shadows never pure black; no spell glow. Fill the whole canvas; no border, no vignette.

Copy the output from $CODEX_HOME/generated_images/... to out/ with the exact name above and compute its sha256. No code. No other files. No web. No agents.
RETURN: the receipt (task_id "K5-plate-K1"): images = the file with prompt, references (none), elapsed_s; calls_used = 1; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS / FAILED; concerns naming anything you could not honour. Never PASS/FAIL.
